series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend directions and moderate seasonality, but high noise levels and unstable model rankings suggest using a weighted combination approach with inverse RMSE weights to avoid over-reliance on single models.

reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.494 AND combination_recommendation.strategy_type=weighted → inverse RMSE weighting with shrinkage (0.35) to balance model performance variation and regularization needs
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false AND combination_recommendation.top_k=4 → per-horizon top-4 averaging to exploit differentiated model performance across horizons
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.0292) → trimmed mean with 10% trimming to mitigate impact of unstable rankings

excluded_highlights.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false AND n_windows=2 → per-horizon selection too unstable with only 2 validation windows
